mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS merchant_id,m.owner_user_id,m.status AS merchant_status,s.id AS store_id,s.status AS store_status FROM merchant m JOIN merchant_store s ON s.merchant_id=m.id WHERE m.id=#{merchantId} AND s.id=#{storeId} AND m.owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM merchant_application WHERE reserved_merchant_id=#{merchantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM merchant_staff WHERE store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM merchant_staff WHERE id=#{staffId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_staff SET staff_name=#{staffName},phone=#{phone},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{staffId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE merchant_staff SET service_enabled=1,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{staffId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND employment_status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id,canonical_version,params_sha256,params_canonical,status,receipt_json FROM merchant_command_idempotency WHERE request_key=#{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_command_idempotency SET status='SUCCEEDED',receipt_json=#{receiptJson},succeeded_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key=#{requestKey} AND status='RESERVED'
